questions.qtext: The Heisler charts are extensively used to determine the temperature distribution and heat flow rate when

options.text: conduction resistance dominates and convection resistance is negligible
convection resistance dominates and conduction resistance is negligible
both conduction and convection resistance are negligible
conduction and convection resistance are of nearly equal importance

questions.solution:
(d)
• Heisler charts are used when biot number is greater than 0.1 and lumped analysis cannot be applied.
• When biot number is greater than 0.1, the internal temperature gradient are not small and so internal resistance cannot be neglected.
So, Heisler charts are used when both conduction and convection resistance are almost of equal importance.

questions.qtext: Which of the following statements regarding modes of heat transfer is correct?

options.text: Conduction in solids is due to vibration of the molecules in a lattice only
Radiation is a mode of heat transfer in which heat is transferred by electrons and does not require a medium
Heat transfer in still fluid (no bulk motion) is by conduction and possibly by radiation
Rate of heat conduction depends upon the geometry of the medium

questions.solution:
(c, d)
• Conduction is solids is due to vibrations of the molecules in a lattice and energy transport by free electrons.
• The rate of heat conduction through a medium depends on the geometry of the medium, its
thickness and the material of the medium.
• Radiation is a mode of heat transfer in which heat is transferred by electromagnetic waves
(photons) and does not require a medium.
